t: If the eccentricity and the length of the latus rectum of an ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1 are √3/2 and 1 respectively, then the sum of the lengths of major axis and minor axis of the ellipse is
s: Given,Equation of ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1, eccentricity e=√3/2 and length of latusrectum 2b²/a=1 ...........(1)Now we know that formula of eccentricity b²=a²(1−e²) so by using this we get b²/a²=1−3/4=1/4 ........(2)Now by solving equation (1) & (2) we get,a=2 & b=1So sum of major axis and minor axis will be 4+2=6.
